themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Covers AI agents acting autonomously or semi-autonomously in research workflows, decision-making, and task execution.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Focuses on AI tools that assist developers in writing, debugging, and understanding code, including security vulnerabilities found in these tools.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Articles discussing various AI-powered tools and platforms used for research purposes, including comparisons and evaluations.

themes.name: AI survey tools
themes.description: Explores AI applications in survey design, analysis, and prediction of user responses.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Covers AI applications directly impacting the design process and user research methodologies, including AI's role as a design partner.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Articles focused on AI's ability to condense large amounts of text, data, or conversations into concise summaries.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Discusses AI-generated personas, faces, and content, and their perceived trustworthiness or impact.

themes.name: AI usability testing
themes.description: Focuses on AI's role in automating or enhancing the process of testing the usability of software and systems.

themes.name: AI sentiment & feedback analysis
themes.description: Covers AI's application in understanding user emotions, opinions, and feedback from various sources.

themes.name: AI for product management
themes.description: Articles that detail how AI is being used to support product managers in their decision-making and strategy.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
